infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: TicTrack needs access to your camera to scan business cards and extract contact information.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: TicTrack needs access to your photo library to select business card images for scanning.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: TicTrack needs access to your contacts to save business card information directly to your address book.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: TicTrack uses Face ID to secure your API key and sensitive information.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow TicTrack to access your camera to scan business cards.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow TicTrack to access your contacts to save business card information.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow TicTrack to access your photos to select business cards.
